ops.new:
-- rc20 (the owner: the Persian hover label of the map is hard to read on the parchment): the
-- font flags of the in-place text. The hover label always gets a black outline; the other
-- surfaces keep the outline their own game font had (the arrival text, the minimap text).
local function flags_of(o)
    local f = o and o.flags
    if type(f) ~= "string" then
        f = ""
    end
    if string.find(f, "THICKOUTLINE", 1, true) then
        return "THICKOUTLINE"
    end
    if string.find(f, "OUTLINE", 1, true) or (o and o.kind == "map") then
        return "OUTLINE"
    end
    return ""
end
F.ZoneFlags = flags_of

local function refont(fs)
    local o = original[fs]
    if not o or writing[fs] or not M.active then

ops.old: pcall(fs.SetFont, fs, F.FONT, o.size or T.Size(), "")
ops.new: pcall(fs.SetFont, fs, F.FONT, o.size or T.Size(), flags_of(o))

original[fs].kind = kind
    fs:SetFont(F.FONT, (original[fs].size or T.Size()), flags_of(original[fs]))

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------ rc20: map label outline
do
    local okF, errF = pcall(function()
        local fl = F.ZoneFlags
        check("rc20: the hover label gets a black outline", fl({ kind = "map", flags = "" }) == "OUTLINE", tostring(fl({ kind = "map", flags = "" })))
        check("rc20: a thick outline stays thick", fl({ kind = "map", flags = "THICKOUTLINE" }) == "THICKOUTLINE")
        check("rc20: the minimap text keeps its own outline", fl({ kind = "minimap", flags = "OUTLINE" }) == "OUTLINE")
        check("rc20: the minimap text without one stays plain", fl({ kind = "minimap", flags = "" }) == "")
    end)
    check("rc20 tests ran", okF, errF)
end
